title: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Identify the audience and authority of the guidance immediately, so partners know the document concerns their use of another organization’s identity.
strategic_value: The restrained blue cover and small IBM signature can establish recognition while making the third-party scope explicit.
demonstration: A pale-blue field holds a two-line title above a small corporate name and a bottom-right IBM logo.
practical_value: Distinguish this third-party usage guide from IBM’s internal design language before applying its rules.

content_islands.name: Title
content_islands.spec: Set the guide title in the upper-left portion of the main text alignment.

content_islands.name: Corporate identification
content_islands.spec: Place the full corporate name near the lower left and the 8-bar mark at the lower right.

reference_purposes.Expression: The cover uses a pale-blue field, restrained type and an isolated IBM 8-bar mark.
